nodes.label:
Select economically material U.S. sectors
each contributes more than 5% of GDP
retain 9 sectors

Select predominantly digital occupations
GPT-4o classifies O*NET tasks; ≥60% digital
top wage/employment choices yield 44 occupations

Recruit and qualify occupation experts
interview · background check · training · quiz
≥4 years' experience; 14 years on average

Experts author authentic work products
request + optional reference files + deliverable
map each task to an O*NET work activity

Record economic and realism metadata
difficulty · representativeness · completion time
estimated value = expert time × occupation wage

Screen, review, comment, and revise
automated checks plus at least 3 human reviews
5 human reviews per task on average

Assemble the full benchmark
1,320 tasks · at least 30 per occupation
average task requires about 7 expert-hours

Release the 220-task gold subset
5 tasks per occupation with request/reference files
scrub expert identifiers from deliverables

Generate model deliverables
three independent samples per task
compare complete artifacts, not short answers

Blind occupation experts to provenance
pair model output against human deliverable
3 graders × 3 samples = 9 comparisons per task

Report head-to-head deliverable win rate
human expert work is the reference baseline
experimental grader: 66% vs 71% human agreement
